subject: a lean Greek man of Syracuse in the 3rd century BC with short curly dark hair greying at the temples and a short trimmed beard, wearing a plain undyed wool chiton and a draped himation cloak, sandals, ink-stained fingers, intense thoughtful eyes

panels.01-syracuse: the ancient Greek harbour city of Syracuse in Sicily around 287 BC at sunrise, stone city walls, Doric temples on the island of Ortygia, merchant ships with square sails in the great harbour, fishermen hauling nets, calm sea, wide establishing shot, 3rd century BC
panels.02-alexandria: a young {S} in his twenties reading papyrus scrolls at a long wooden table in a great colonnaded library in Alexandria, Egypt, shelves of scroll pigeonholes, an older scholar beside him pointing at a geometric diagram, warm lamplight, 3rd century BC
panels.03-lever: {S} in a stone courtyard workshop in Syracuse demonstrating a long wooden lever on a stone fulcrum, one hand pressing the far end, a heavy marble block rising easily at the short end, young assistants watching in wonder, a wax tablet with a balance diagram on a bench, bright Mediterranean light, 3rd century BC, the joy of discovery
panels.04-ship: one single {S}, alone in the foreground, pulling a rope through a wooden pulley block fixed to a post on the beach at Syracuse, hauling a large ancient Greek cargo ship up the sand: a broad curved wooden hull with an upturned stern, ONE single short mast with ONE square sail, two large steering oars, King Hiero and a crowd watching in amazement
panels.05-sphere: {S} kneeling on a stone floor drawing a sphere inside a cylinder with a stick in fine sand spread on a flat board, compass and ruler beside him, scrolls and an oil lamp, deep concentration, quiet study room at night, 3rd century BC
panels.06-floating: {S} at a workbench studying a wooden block floating in a large bronze basin of water, a smaller vessel catching the water that spills over, a balance scale and small weights nearby, a golden wreath resting on a cloth, curious and focused, Greek workshop, 3rd century BC
panels.07-walls: an elderly {S} with white hair on the stone battlements of Syracuse, pointing and directing engineers who work a huge wooden crane with ropes and a great iron grappling hook, Roman warships held back far out at sea, wind and spray, strategy and leadership, no fighting, 213 BC
panels.08-tomb: a Roman official in a toga and his Sicilian guides with scythes clearing thick briers and bushes from an old overgrown tomb outside a city gate, revealing a small stone column carved with a sphere and a cylinder, late afternoon sunlight, sense of rediscovery, 75 BC
